title: Personal Training Packages: how an active corporate wellness enrollment reduces the late-cancellation fee
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Personal Training Packages product line and states how holding an active corporate wellness enrollment reduces the flat fee charged for a late cancellation.

## Rule
The charge for a late cancellation starts from the tier's own flat late-cancellation fee. Where the member holds an active corporate wellness enrollment, that enrollment's own employer discount percentage reduces the chargeable fee, with only half of that percentage's weight applied to the reduction; where no active corporate wellness enrollment is held, no reduction applies and the full tier fee is charged.

## Points of judgement
- What is held: an active corporate wellness enrollment.
- What value it contributes: that enrollment's own employer discount percentage.
- What effect it has: only half of that percentage reduces the tier's flat late-cancellation fee; the fee is never reduced by the full percentage.
As a hypothetical illustration only (not any tier's actual listed fee), suppose a tier's flat fee were 100.00 dollars and the linked active corporate wellness enrollment's own employer discount percentage were 20 percent: half of that percentage -- 10 percent -- would reduce the fee, leaving a charge of 90.00 dollars before any habitual surcharge. Where the member holds no active corporate wellness enrollment, or holds one that is not active, the fee is charged in full with no reduction.
